biography:
Doublespeak is a British singer-songwriter project formed by Vince Clarke, Neil Arthur, and Benge. The trio brought together Clarke’s long-running synth-pop pedigree from Depeche Mode, Yazoo, and Erasure, Arthur’s work as the voice of Blancmange, and Benge’s background as an electronic musician and producer to create a new collaborative outfit centered on reimagined songs and cover versions.

The project came together after Clarke and Arthur, who had known each other for decades, developed the idea with Benge joining later as producer and collaborator. Doublespeak’s self-titled debut was released in 2026 and featured reinterpretations of songs by artists such as ABBA, Young Marble Giants, the Magnetic Fields, the Carpenters, and Fad Gadget, highlighting the group’s interest in transforming influential material through their shared pop and electronic sensibility.
name: Doublespeak
